title: Vets market investigation: draft substantive Order and Undertakings
summary: The CMA published a draft substantive order and consultation notice for its veterinary services market investigation. It would impose new requirements on veterinary businesses in the UK, including transparency, pricing, prescriptions, complaints and switching measures, and requires the RCVS to support and monitor compliance. This is a draft only, so firms should review the proposed remedies and prepare for possible implementation.

title: Vivisol / Air Liquide (home oxygen services business) merger inquiry
summary: The CMA is inviting comments on Vivisol’s proposed acquisition of Air Liquide’s home oxygen services business in the UK. Interested parties can submit views during the phase 1 invitation-to-comment period, which closes in late September 2026. This is part of the CMA’s merger information-gathering process, not a final decision or binding rule.

title: Strategic review of CMA markets remedies
summary: The CMA is conducting a strategic review of 33 market remedies, with a provisional decision consultation open until 11 September 2026 and a final decision due in October 2026. It covers remedies across several sectors, including financial services. Firms affected by CMA undertakings or orders may want to assess whether any remedy changes could affect their business.

title: Provisional decision: strategic review of CMA markets remedies
summary: The CMA has published a provisional decision in its strategic review of legacy markets remedies, proposing to revoke, release or vary a range of existing Enterprise Act remedies and undertakings. The document is a consultation-style interim decision and does not itself change obligations yet. Firms affected by the named remedies should monitor the final order and any notice periods.

title: nexfibre / Substantial merger inquiry
summary: The UK CMA has accepted a fast-track reference request and referred Liberty Global/Telefónica/InfraVia’s proposed acquisition of nexfibre’s target business to a phase 2 merger investigation under the Enterprise Act 2002. This is a competition-law procedural decision affecting the parties to the transaction, with no new substantive obligations for the wider market.

title: FirstCash / Ramsdens merger inquiry
summary: The CMA has opened a Phase 1 merger inquiry and is inviting comments on FirstCash Holdings Inc.’s proposed acquisition of Ramsdens Holdings PLC. Interested parties can submit views on UK competition issues by 4 September 2026. This is an information-gathering step before any formal investigation, not a final decision or rule change.

title: Referral of the proposed Scottish Zero Emission Truck Fund Scheme by Transport Scotland
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit has opened a referral on Transport Scotland’s proposed Scottish Zero Emission Truck Fund. Third parties can submit comments by the deadline in the timetable. The report will assess whether the scheme complies with subsidy control requirements; no direct obligations are created for regulated firms.

title: Schlumberger / ChampionX merger inquiry
summary: The CMA has published an invitation to comment on Schlumberger’s proposed acquisition of ChampionX. Interested parties can submit initial views by 2024-12-10. This is an early merger-review information-gathering step and does not itself impose new requirements on firms.

title: Referral of the proposed Contracts for Difference for Renewables Allocation Round 8 scheme by DESNZ
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit has published its final report on DESNZ’s proposed Contracts for Difference Allocation Round 8 scheme for Great Britain. It evaluates the scheme against the Subsidy Control Act 2022 and describes changes to the AR8 scheme, including eligibility, technology categories and auction mechanics. It is an advisory report, not a binding rule, and no action date is set for firms.

title: Google search fair ranking conduct requirement
summary: The CMA publishes interpretative notes explaining how Google must comply with its Fair Ranking Conduct Requirement for UK general search services. The notes clarify scope, non-discrimination, transparency and complaint-handling expectations, including ranking of organic results, AI search features and related search features. Google must use them for compliance reporting while the conduct requirement is in force.

title: Chartering and Field of Membership for Federal Credit Unions-Interpretive Ruling and Policy Statement 10-1
summary: NCUA rescinds IRPS 10-1 as a separate policy for federal credit unions, because the Chartering Manual already contains the current chartering and field-of-membership requirements. The change does not alter substantive requirements, but it reduces the number of sources FCUs must consult. It is effective 2026-09-08.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 3100, Interpretation and Policy .06, To Reduce the Waiting Periods for Retaking FINRA Qualification Examinations
summary: MIAX Pearl filed and immediately made effective a rule change reducing the waiting periods for retaking failed FINRA qualification exams under Exchange Rule 3100. The change applies to Exchange members and associated persons who must pass representative or principal qualification exams. No separate compliance date is stated beyond immediate effectiveness.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX PEARL, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Pearl Options Exchange Fee Schedule To Amend Certain Fees and Rebates Applicable to Transactions in Non-Penny Classes for Certain Origins
summary: MIAX Pearl filed a fee schedule amendment that immediately became effective under SEC exchange rule procedures. It changes maker rebates and taker fees for certain non-Penny options classes and origins. The change applies to MIAX Pearl options market participants, including market makers, firms, and other professional origins, with no separate compliance date stated in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Equity 4, Rule 4120 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: Nasdaq has filed an immediately effective rule change to update and conform its Equity 4, Rule 4120 trading-halt framework before the previously approved version becomes operative. The change is for Nasdaq members, issuers and market participants, and the operative date is August 10, 2026; the SEC notice solicits comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Correct an Internal Cross-Reference Error in Rule 23.150
summary: IEX filed an immediately effective exchange rule change to fix an internal cross-reference in Rule 23.150 so it points to the correct definition in Rule 22.160. The change is a technical correction only and does not alter system functionality or processes. The SEC notice invites comments, but the filing is effective immediately under the Exchange Act.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MX2 LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposal To Amend Rule 20.6 (Nullification and Adjustment of Options Transactions Including Obvious Errors) Regarding the Roster Requirements for the Obvious Error Panel
summary: MX2 LLC filed an immediately effective rule change to amend its options obvious error rule by removing the minimum roster requirement for panel representatives. The panel composition itself stays the same, and the SEC published the filing for comment. This affects MX2 options members and exchange rule administration from 2026-08-31.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the Plan for the Purpose of Developing and Implementing Procedures Designed To Facilitate the Listing and Trading of Standardized Options To Add MX2 LLC as a Plan Sponsor
summary: The SEC published notice that MX2 LLC has been added as a sponsor to the Options Listing Procedures Plan, which governs procedures for listing and trading standardized options. This affects options exchanges and plan participants; the notice was published for comment but does not itself create new firm obligations.

title: Merger assessment guidelines
summary: The CMA updated its merger assessment guidelines, replacing the section on merger efficiencies. The revised guidance takes effect on 3 September 2026 and applies to merger cases where the formal phase 1 investigation starts on or after that date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Connectivity Fee Schedule
summary: NYSE filed and immediately made effective a rulebook fee-schedule update to rename two colocation and network data feed references from CTA/CQ to their actual names, CTS and CQS. The change is non-substantive and reflects an upcoming NMS plan transition from April 1, 2027. Interested persons may comment on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MEMX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Fee Schedule
summary: The SEC published notice of MEMX LLC’s immediately effective rule filing to amend its options fee schedule. The changes adjust rebates and fees for several customer, market maker, professional, firm, away market maker and broker-dealer categories, and add a new customer volume tier. The exchange said it planned to implement the changes on 2026-09-01.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend Rule 7.18E Regarding Initial Listing Regulatory Halts
summary: NYSE American filed an immediately effective rule change to clarify Rule 7.18E on initial listing regulatory halts. It states the halt does not apply to IPOs and that trading resumes via a Trading Halt Auction after the halt ends. The filing is published for comment and is effective immediately, with no separate compliance date stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.15(a) To Clarify That a Non-Member May Act as a Clearing Firm
summary: Cboe BZX filed an immediately effective rule change clarifying that a non-member firm may act as a clearing firm under Rule 11.15(a). The change affects exchange members using clearing arrangements and is already effective upon filing, with SEC comment solicitation continuing after publication.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the NYSE Arca Options Fee Schedule To Modify the Broker QCC Credit and Manual Billable Rebate Program
summary: NYSE Arca is immediately amending its options fee schedule, effective September 14, 2026, to lower volume thresholds for broker QCC credits and adjust the manual billable rebate program for floor brokers. This affects exchange participants trading NYSE Arca options and has already taken effect, though the SEC notice is also soliciting comments on the filing.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Amend NYSE American Rule 2.1210
summary: NYSE American filed and immediately made effective a rule change amending Rule 2.1210 to shorten the waiting periods for retaking failed FINRA qualification exams, aligning with FINRA’s recent exam-rule amendment. The change applies to member organizations, ETP Holders and ATP Holders. The notice solicits comments, but the exchange rule change is already effective.

title: Referral of the proposed subsidy to EDF Energy Nuclear Generation Ltd by the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit published a report on DESNZ’s proposed subsidy for EDF Energy Nuclear Generation Ltd to support the long-term operation of Sizewell B. It is an assessment of compliance under the Subsidy Control Act 2022 and invites third-party comments, but it does not itself create obligations for firms.

title: Energy licence modification appeals 2026
summary: Cadent Gas Limited has filed a notice of appeal in the Competition and Markets Authority against GEMA’s RIIO-GD3 licence modification decision for the 1 April 2026 gas price control period. The appeal challenges the 1% ongoing efficiency challenge and the related licence conditions affecting Cadent’s allowed revenue and obligations under its gas transporter licence.

title: In the Matter of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Order Granting Petitions for Review and Scheduling Filing of Statements Regarding an Order Approving a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 1, To Adopt a New Continued Listing Requirement
summary: The SEC granted petitions to review an order approving Nasdaq’s proposed continued listing requirement and kept that approval stayed pending further Commission order. Parties or other persons may file statements supporting or opposing the approval order by 2026-10-06. This is a procedural Commission notice, not a new rule or obligation for firms.

title: Cybersecurity: Cybersecurity Supervision Work Program
summary: The OCC published a cybersecurity supervision work program for banks. It signals supervisory expectations and focus areas for cybersecurity oversight, but the excerpt does not show new binding rules or deadlines.

title: CFTC Releases Staff Advisory on Mention Markets
summary: The CFTC Division of Market Oversight issued staff advisory guidance on “mention market” event contracts for designated contract markets. It explains when such contracts may be listed under CEA/Commission rules and reminds DCMs of their anti-manipulation obligations and need for complete Part 40 submissions. No fixed deadline is set; the advisory applies immediately as supervisory guidance.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of Michigan Affected by Severe Storms, Tornadoes, and Flooding
summary: The FDIC issued supervisory relief for FDIC-supervised financial institutions in Michigan affected by severe storms, tornadoes and flooding. It is guidance on how affected banks should handle the disruption and recovery process; the publication itself does not create new binding requirements. Applies immediately to FDIC-supervised institutions in the affected areas.

title: Financial Institution Letter: FDIC Office of Supervisory Appeals Is Operational
summary: The FDIC says its new Office of Supervisory Appeals is now operational and the revised Guidelines for Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations take effect on 2026-08-04. It applies to all FDIC-supervised financial institutions and changes the final review process for material supervisory determinations.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Revised Procedures for Processing Federal Deposit Insurance Applications
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter revising procedures for processing federal deposit insurance applications for proposed insured depository institutions. It introduces a two-phase process with a contingent authorization within 120 days and a final approval within the following 12 months, with coordination with the chartering authority and pre-opening conditions confirmed before opening.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of West Virginia Affected by Severe Storms
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter offering supervisory relief to help FDIC-supervised financial institutions recover from severe storms in West Virginia. It applies to all FDIC-supervised institutions, with particular relevance to those operating in the affected area. No specific compliance deadline or new rule is stated.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of Mississippi Affected by Tropical Storm Arthur
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter offering supervisory relief and recovery support for FDIC-supervised financial institutions in Mississippi affected by Tropical Storm Arthur. It is applicable immediately to all FDIC-supervised institutions in the affected area; no new filing date or hard compliance deadline is stated.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Rescission of Interagency Statement on Special Purpose Credit Programs Under the Equal Credit Opportunity Act and Regulation B
summary: FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter telling FDIC-supervised institutions that the interagency statement on special purpose credit programs under ECOA/Regulation B has been rescinded. The change is effective via the agencies’ Federal Register notice dated 2026-08-25 and means firms should not rely on the rescinded statement when designing or operating such programs.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Supervisory Relief to Help Financial Institutions and Facilitate Recovery in Areas of the  Northern Mariana Islands Affected by Super Typhoon Bavi
summary: The FDIC issued a Financial Institution Letter offering supervisory relief to help FDIC-supervised institutions recover in areas of the Northern Mariana Islands affected by Super Typhoon Bavi. It applies to all FDIC-supervised financial institutions, with operational response expected immediately and no specific compliance deadline stated.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Joint Statement on Suspicious Activity Report Confidentiality Considerations Regarding Communications with Customers
summary: The FDIC and other US agencies issued a joint statement reminding FDIC-insured institutions about SAR confidentiality when communicating with customers about suspicious or potentially fraudulent activity, including payment fraud and account closures. It is immediate guidance for all FDIC-insured financial institutions; no specific compliance date is given.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Frequently Asked Questions Regarding Treatment of Verifiable Digital Credentials Under the Customer Identification Program Rule
summary: FDIC and other US agencies issued FAQs on using state-issued mobile driver’s licences and other government digital credentials to verify natural-person customers under CIP, and updated a prior FAQ’s terminology for verifiable digital credentials. It applies to FDIC-insured financial institutions immediately; no separate compliance date is stated.

title: Establish Prices for 2026 United States Mint Numismatic Products
summary: The US Mint announced retail prices for certain 2026 numismatic gold and clad products, effective 2026-08-14. It also noted that precious-metal product pricing may be adjusted weekly based on the LBMA gold price average.

title: Establish Price for 2026 Freedom 250 Race Medal
summary: The U.S. Mint announced the price of $60 for the 2026 Freedom 250 Race Medal and said orders open on 2026-08-21 and run through 2026-09-04, subject to a 15,000-unit limit. This is a product availability notice, not a regulatory change.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Rules at Options 7, Section 4 (Complex Order Fees and Rebates) and Section 6 (Other Options Fees and Rebates)
summary: Nasdaq ISE filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options fee and rebate schedule for complex orders and other options fees. The notice solicits public comments but does not itself impose a new compliance deadline in the text provided. It affects exchange participants trading options on Nasdaq ISE.

title: Danone / Huel merger inquiry
summary: The CMA has published a merger notice for Danone Holdings (UK)’s anticipated acquisition of Huel Limited. It starts the CMA’s initial review period and sets the phase 2 reference decision deadline for 11 September 2026. This is a competition-law notice affecting the parties to the transaction, not a conduct rule for firms generally.

title: Order Making Fiscal Year 2027 Annual Adjustments to Registration Fee Rates
summary: The SEC announces the FY 2027 annual adjustment to securities registration fee rates, which affects issuers filing registration statements and related Exchange Act fee calculations. It updates the target fee collection amount and applies the statutory methodology for calculating the new rate. The order is effective for FY 2027; no firm-specific filing deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: The Brink’s Company / NCR Atleos Corporation merger inquiry
summary: The UK CMA has published a notice confirming the merger notice for The Brink’s Company’s proposed acquisition of NCR Atleos Corporation meets statutory requirements. The CMA’s initial review period starts on 27 August 2026, and it must decide by 22 October 2026 whether to refer the merger for a phase 2 investigation.

title: Program for Allocation of Regulatory Responsibilities Pursuant to Rule 17d-2; Notice of Filing and Order Approving and Declaring Effective an Amendment to the Plan for the Allocation of Regulatory Responsibilities Among Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc., BOX Exchange, LLC, Cboe Exchange, Inc., Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc., Nasdaq ISE, LLC, Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc., Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC, NYSE American LLC, NYSE Arca, Inc., The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, Nasdaq Texas LLC, Nasdaq PHLX LLC, Nasdaq GEMX, LLC, Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc., Nasdaq MRX, LLC, MIAX PEARL, LLC, MIAX Emerald, LLC, MIAX Sapphire, LLC, MEMX LLC, MX2 LLC and Investors Exchange LLC Concerning Options-Related Sales Practice Matters
summary: The SEC approved and made effective an amended Rule 17d-2 plan allocating regulatory responsibilities among multiple U.S. options exchanges and FINRA for options-related sales practice matters. It affects how member-firm regulatory exams and enforcement duties are shared, but it does not create new substantive conduct requirements for firms. No compliance date is stated beyond the order becoming effective.

title: OCC Issues Fourth Quarter 2026 and First Quarter 2027 CRA Evaluation Schedule
summary: The OCC published a schedule of upcoming CRA evaluations for named banks across multiple US states, listing the month of examination. This is an informational notice only; it does not create new requirements, but firms listed should note the planned evaluation window.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe C2 filed a fee-schedule change, immediately effective, to create an Order Entry Protocol Migration Program that can credit Trading Permit Holders for temporary backup logical ports used during exchange-initiated protocol migrations. The notice seeks SEC comments; no firm-wide compliance deadline is stated, but affected exchange participants should review eligibility and billing impacts.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program
summary: Cboe BZX filed and the SEC noticed an immediately effective fee schedule change to create an Order Entry Protocol Migration Program. Eligible members can receive credits for backup logical port fees during an exchange-initiated migration, subject to notification, cancellation, and credit-request conditions. No firm-wide regulatory deadline is set in the notice.

title: Sunshine Act Meetings
summary: The SEC announced a change to the time of a previously scheduled closed Sunshine Act meeting, moving it from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. on September 10, 2026. This is an informational meeting notice only and does not create obligations for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule
summary: The SEC published notice that Cboe EDGX filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options fees schedule. The change adds MX2 to one routed customer fee code and increases a non-customer routing fee from $1.25 to $1.31 per contract, effective September 1, 2026. The filing also solicits public comments.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Rule 15b9-1
summary: The SEC is seeking OMB review of an information collection tied to amended Rule 15b9-1 for broker-dealers relying on the stock-option order exemption. It does not itself change the rule, but it describes written policy and recordkeeping burdens for affected broker-dealers under the SEC’s existing exemption framework.

title: Vandemoortele / Délifrance merger inquiry
summary: The CMA has published a merger notice for Vandemoortele’s anticipated acquisition of Délifrance and confirmed the phase 1 review timetable under the Enterprise Act 2002. The initial period starts on 13 October 2025 and the CMA’s referral deadline is 8 December 2025. This is a market/operational notice for the parties and does not impose bank compliance obligations.

title: Joint Industry Plan; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Amendment to the National Market System Plan Governing the Consolidated Audit Trail To Add MX2 LLC as a Participant
summary: The SEC published notice that an amendment to the CAT NMS Plan became immediately effective to add MX2 LLC as a participant. Interested persons may submit comments, and the Commission can abrogate the amendment within 60 days. This is mainly an operational market-structure notice for exchange participants, not a new substantive rule for firms.

title: Baillie Giffords Funds, et al.
summary: The SEC issued a notice of an exemptive application from Baillie Gifford Funds and related applicants seeking relief to launch a multi-class ETF structure combining ETF shares and mutual fund classes. It is a notice of a requested order, not a final rule or obligation, and interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-24.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Application for Certificate Discharging Property Subject to Estate Tax Lien
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on an existing information collection under the Paperwork Reduction Act for estate tax lien discharge forms. It does not change the forms or create new requirements; comments are due by 2026-10-02.

title: Yorkville America Investment Trust and Yorkville America Equities, LLC
summary: SEC notice that Yorkville America Investment Trust and Yorkville America Equities, LLC applied for exemptive relief from certain Investment Company Act and disclosure requirements to allow subadvisory agreements to be entered into or materially amended without shareholder approval. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-08-25. This is a notice of an application, not the relief itself.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Change To Amend Its Rules To Extend Trading Hours for Certain Eligible Equity Options
summary: The SEC announced it is extending the deadline to act on NYSE American’s proposed rule change to lengthen trading hours for certain eligible equity options. This is not a substantive rule change; it only gives the Commission until 2026-09-20 to approve, disapprove, or institute proceedings.

title: Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee Public Meeting
summary: The U.S. Mint announced a public Citizens Coinage Advisory Committee meeting on August 6, 2026 to review proposed design portfolios for a Freedom 250 Grand Prix medal program. This is an informational meeting notice only; members of the public may observe or submit comments, but no regulatory requirements are created.

title: Venture capital access expanded for early-stage companies in UK
summary: HMT announced a £100 million expansion of the British Business Bank’s Investor Pathways Capital Initiative to support new venture capital funds for early-stage UK companies, with applications for the next cohort opening in autumn 2026. It is a policy/news announcement about government funding support, not a binding rule or consultation.

title: Renewal of the Innovation Advisory Committee
summary: The CFTC announced renewal of its Innovation Advisory Committee for two years. The committee will advise on technological innovation, new technologies, and related issues in derivatives and commodities markets; it does not itself impose new requirements on firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to Foreign Status and U.S. Withholding Certifications
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an extension of the existing information collection for Forms W-8 and related foreign status and U.S. withholding certifications. There are no changes to the burden or filing requirements in this notice. Comments are due by 2026-10-13.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Application for Determination for Employee Benefit Plan
summary: The IRS is requesting public comments on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for Form 5300, used by eligible plan sponsors to seek determination letters for certain employee benefit plans. Comments are due by 2026-10-13. The notice updates burden estimates but does not change substantive tax or plan qualification rules.

title: AMG BBH Asset-Backed Credit Fund, LLC, et al.; August 10, 2026.
summary: The SEC published a notice of application for exemptive relief allowing certain business development companies and closed-end management investment companies to co-invest with affiliated entities. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-04. This is a notice, not the order itself, so it does not yet change obligations.

title: The CMA's programme of work across mobile platforms
summary: The CMA published an update on its programme of work on Apple and Google’s mobile platforms under the UK digital markets regime. It describes past SMS designations and ongoing work on app review, app ranking, data use, interoperability, NFC access and app steering, including consultations and future expected consultations in 2026. This is an informational status update, not a binding rule or decision.

title: Northern Lights Fund Trust and Ocean Park Asset Management, LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Northern Lights Fund Trust and Ocean Park Asset Management seeking exemptive relief to launch a multi-class ETF structure with ETF and mutual fund share classes. It is a notice of a pending application, not a rule or order, so there is no direct obligation yet. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-08.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form SF-3
summary: The SEC announced submission to OMB for extension of the existing information collection for Form SF-3, used by asset-backed securities issuers to register public shelf offerings. The notice invites public comments by 2026-09-18. No new substantive filing rule is created here.

title: Enhanced road fuel monitoring report: August 2026
summary: CMA published an enhanced monitoring report on UK road fuel prices and margins in response to the Middle East conflict, and on its Fuel Finder compliance/enforcement work. It is an informational market update, not a rule or enforcement notice, and creates no new deadlines or obligations for firms.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Equity 4, Rule 3100 Regarding Trading Halts
summary: The SEC published notice of Nasdaq PHLX’s proposed rule change to update Equity 4, Rule 3100 on trading halts so the text matches the exchange’s current operative rule and related cross-references. It is a notice seeking comments on an exchange filing, not a final rule. No direct obligation is created by the notice itself.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Comment Request on Improving Customer Experience (OMB Circular A-11, Section 280 Implementation)
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments on an existing information collection related to improving customer experience under OMB Circular A-11 Section 280. It updates burden estimates and invites comments by 2026-10-19. No new substantive requirements are created for firms.

title: Clearlake Private Markets Fund and Clearlake Capital RIC Management, LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by Clearlake Private Markets Fund and Clearlake Capital RIC Management, LLC seeking exemptive relief from several Investment Company Act provisions to allow multiple share classes, early withdrawal charges, and asset-based distribution/service fees. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-11.

title: Eagle Point Credit Management LLC and Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Company
summary: The SEC published a notice that Eagle Point Credit Management LLC and Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Company have applied for exemptive relief to allow certain BDCs/closed-end funds to offer multiple share classes with varying sales loads and asset-based distribution or service fees. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-11. This is a notice of an application, not a rule.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission for OMB Review; Comment Request; Extension: Form ADV
summary: The SEC published a notice seeking public comment on its request to extend the OMB approval for Form ADV, the mandatory registration/reporting form for investment advisers and exempt reporting advisers. The comment period closes on 2026-09-21. This is an information-collection notice, not a rule change.

title: Referral of the proposed subsidy to Ryanair UK Limited by Invest Northern Ireland
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit has opened a referral on a proposed £67 million subsidy from Invest Northern Ireland to Ryanair UK Limited for an aircraft engine MRO facility in Northern Ireland. Third parties may submit comments by the deadline in the timetable; the SAU will publish a report within 30 working days. This is an information notice, not a rule or decision.

title: FDIC Board of Directors Approve New Actions
summary: FDIC published a board-matters bulletin announcing that its Board unanimously approved a final rule on unsafe or unsound practices and matters requiring attention, and an interim final rule on reciprocal deposits under the Road to Housing Act. The notice points readers to related board materials, press releases and the financial institution letters.

title: Interim Chair of National Savings and Investments appointment extended
summary: HM Treasury announced an extension of Luke Jensen’s interim chair appointment to the NS&I Board for two more months, from 1 September to 31 October 2026, while a permanent chair is appointed. The notice also references the public appointments code and NS&I’s governance role, but it does not create new obligations for firms.

title: Ministers to boost innovation in payments with new objective for Bank of England
summary: HMT announces plans to give the Bank of England a new secondary objective to support innovation in payment systems and emerging forms of digital money, including stablecoins. The objective would sit below the Bank’s financial stability objective and extend the existing innovation approach for CCPs and CSDs. No date is fixed for implementation; Parliament is expected to debate amendments in September.

title: SEC and FDA Announce MOU to Bolster Cooperation and Ensure Market Integrity
summary: The SEC and FDA announced an MOU to improve information-sharing on FDA-regulated products and related market integrity issues. It is a cooperation arrangement, not a new rule, and it does not itself impose compliance deadlines on firms. It may matter to issuers and firms with FDA-related disclosures or products, but it is mainly informational.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (“ORF”)
summary: The SEC published a notice of Cboe EDGX’s proposed rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee schedule, including a higher ORF rate and clarifying edits tied to on-exchange customer-range options transactions. The notice solicits public comments; it does not itself change obligations. The change is described as effective July 1, 2026, under the exchange filing, but the SEC notice is only a publication of the filing.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Advance Notice of Rescission of Health Coverage
summary: The IRS is seeking public comments by 2026-11-02 on a revised Paperwork Reduction Act information collection for advance notices of rescission of health coverage. It does not change the underlying rule, but updates burden estimates for the existing collection tied to the 30-day advance notice requirement.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request on the Burden Related to the Fuel Tax Guidance and Related Third-Party Disclosure and Recordkeeping Requirements
summary: The IRS is seeking public comment by 2026-11-02 on the Paperwork Reduction Act burden associated with fuel tax guidance and related third-party disclosure and recordkeeping requirements. It states there is no substantive change to the underlying requirements; the notice mainly consolidates an existing information collection under one OMB control number.

title: Chancellor takes axe to delays holding back growth
summary: HM Treasury issued a press release on plans to speed up growth and investment, including support for UK unicorns, the Northern 500, new sandbox powers, and reforms to consultation and judicial review for major infrastructure projects. It is a policy announcement rather than a rule or guidance, and it does not create immediate obligations.

title: Procurement in the national interest
summary: The CMA published two policy papers on how UK public procurement can support growth, innovation and economic security, including a call for stronger action against bid rigging through better data use. This is intelligence and advocacy only; it does not set rules, deadlines or obligations for firms.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Revision: Ombudsman Matter Management System (OMMS) Submission Form
summary: The SEC issued a 60-day Paperwork Reduction Act notice seeking comment on a revised OMMS Submission Form for retail investor complaints and inquiries. The form remains voluntary, but the SEC proposes adding a new submitter category and asks for comments on burden, utility and clarity, with comments due by the stated deadline in the notice.

title: Economic Secretary to the Treasury speech at UK Finance
summary: The Economic Secretary gave a speech on the UK’s push to digitalise and tokenise wholesale financial markets, highlighting the Digital Securities Sandbox, future legal changes, and work on the payments ecosystem and digital gilt issuance. It is a policy and progress update, not a rule or supervisory requirement.

title: Referral of the proposed Critical Chemicals Resilience Fund subsidy scheme by the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade
summary: The CMA’s Subsidy Advice Unit has accepted a referral from the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade on the proposed Critical Chemicals Resilience Fund subsidy scheme. Third parties can submit comments for the SAU’s report within the timetable set out in the notice. This is a procedural notice about a review of a proposed UK subsidy scheme, not the scheme itself.

title: Heating oil suppliers: using fair terms and conditions
summary: The CMA published an open letter reminding domestic heating oil suppliers that consumer contract terms must be fair and transparent, especially where liability is limited or excluded. It is a reminder following CMA intervention over cancelled heating oil orders and voluntary compensation, with no new deadline or rule in the letter.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice listing bank holding company formation/acquisition application(s) for public comment. Interested persons may submit views on the applications by 2026-10-13. This is an informational notice only and does not itself approve or impose requirements on firms.

title: Monitoring of the commitments given by IAG to the European Commission in relation to its acquisition of bmi
summary: The CMA says it is monitoring IAG’s commitments to the European Commission relating to IAG’s 2012 acquisition of bmi. This is an informational notice only and does not announce a new obligation or deadline.

title: Funding Opportunity; Notice of Allocation Availability Inviting Applications for the Calendar Years 2026 Allocation Round of the New Markets Tax Credit Program
summary: The Treasury CDFI Fund announced the 2026 New Markets Tax Credit allocation round and its application deadlines, including certification, registration, application, and post-award reporting dates. It offers up to $5 billion of allocation authority and describes the application process and program terms for certified CDEs seeking awards.

title: Sunshine Act Notice: FDIC Board of Directors Meeting
summary: FDIC announced an open Sunshine Act Board meeting on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET, to be observed by webcast or in person at FDIC Headquarters. No regulatory requirements or policy changes are announced.

title: Finance: Interministerial Standing Committee – 17 September 2026
summary: This is a communiqué from the UK Finance: Interministerial Standing Committee describing a meeting of finance ministers. It does not create or change any rules, deadlines, or obligations for firms.

title: Whole of Government Accounts, 2024-25
summary: HM Treasury published the 2024-25 Whole of Government Accounts, a consolidated report on the UK public sector’s financial position and performance. It is an annual informational publication prepared under the Government Resources and Accounts Act 2000 and audited by the NAO, with no new obligations for firms or a compliance deadline.

title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
summary: The Federal Reserve published a notice inviting public comments on applications by 1870 Holdings, Inc. to merge with Rushville Bancshares, Inc. and indirectly acquire Rushville State Bank. Comments must be received by 2026-10-28.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend MSRB Rule G-27 To Exclude Certain Public Finance Activities From Term “Structuring of Public Offerings or Private Placements,” Extend the Length of the Exclusion for Non-Primary Residences From Municipal Branch Office Designation, and Make a Technical Update to the Rule's Title
summary: The MSRB has proposed amendments to Rule G-27 to exclude certain public finance activities from the term "structuring of public offerings or private placements," extend the non-primary residence exclusion from municipal branch office designation, and make a technical title update. SEC is seeking comments; if approved, the MSRB would later announce an operative date and a compliance period of 90 to 180 days after approval.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend FLEX Options Listing Rules
summary: The SEC published a notice of Nasdaq ISE’s proposed rule change to amend FLEX Options listing rules for cash-settled FLEX ETF options. It would expand eligibility for newly qualifying ETFs, add tiered treatment if an ETF later falls below thresholds, and remove the 50-ETF cap. This is a proposal, so firms can comment but no binding change is in force yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Options Regulatory Fee (ORF)
summary: NYSE American filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its Options Regulatory Fee fee schedule, including conforming text and the ORF rate in effect through 31 August 2026 and from 1 September 2026. The SEC is publishing the notice and inviting comments. The filing concerns options market participants using NYSE American and their clearing/pass-through arrangements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Miami International Securities Exchange, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule 515A Related to PRIME and cPRIME Functionality
summary: MIAX filed and immediately made effective a proposed rule change to amend Exchange Rule 515A for PRIME and cPRIME auctions. The change removes the initiating price from RFR messages, so only option, side, and size will be disseminated. MIAX expects to implement the functionality in Q3 2026 and will later announce the exact date.

title: Community Reinvestment Act Regulations
summary: The OCC and FDIC are proposing changes to Community Reinvestment Act regulations and related technical rules for banks, including clearer CRA consideration and reduced burden for community banks. Comments are due by 2026-10-13. This is a consultation only and does not yet change obligations.

title: CMA proposes removing 27 market remedies in part or full following review
summary: The CMA is consulting on a provisional decision to remove 23 market remedies, partially remove 4, and keep 6 in full. The remedies affect areas including retail banking, home credit, private motor insurance, soft drinks, current account switching and LPG. Interested parties can respond by 5pm on 11 September 2026; a final decision is expected in autumn 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq GEMX, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Market Maker Quoting Obligations
summary: Nasdaq GEMX filed a proposed rule change to amend its options market maker quoting obligations by aggregating quoting activity for Primary Market Makers and Preferred Market Makers associated with the same member. The SEC is seeking comments on the proposal; no binding change is made yet.

title: Proposed Establishment of the Mill Creek-Walla Walla Valley Viticultural Area
summary: TTB proposes to establish the Mill Creek—Walla Walla Valley American viticultural area in part 9 of the wine labeling regulations. It is a notice of proposed rulemaking for vintners and related businesses, with comments due by 2026-10-13. The proposal would affect how wines from the area may be described on labels and in advertisements if finalized.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Change To Introduce the New One-Minute Interval Intra-Day Report
summary: NYSE American filed a proposed rule change with the SEC to add a new One-Minute Interval Intra-Day Report for options volume data. The new report would update every minute during the trading day and be available to subscribers within five minutes after each interval. This is a proposal/comment solicitation, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend its Fee Schedule
summary: Cboe BZX filed a proposed rule change to amend its equities fee schedule, including removing Step-Up Tier 2, adding a new Single MPID Investor Tier, and dropping expired liquidity provision rates. The SEC is soliciting comments, and the exchange says it will implement the changes effective August 3, 2026. This affects firms trading on BZX.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the MIAX Sapphire Options Exchange Fee Schedule Regarding the Routing Fee Table
summary: The SEC has published notice of MIAX Sapphire’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its options exchange fee schedule routing fee table. The changes add MX2 and IEX routing categories, reflect Nasdaq BX’s name change to Nasdaq Texas, and adjust MIAX Pearl’s fee tiers. It is effective immediately, with comments invited.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change of Amendments to Rules 7.31, 7.35, and 7.35B
summary: NYSE has filed a proposed rule change, effective immediately under SEC procedures, to amend Rules 7.31, 7.35 and 7.35B on discretionary orders and closing auction mechanics. It would enhance auction imbalance information and change related processing for UTP securities. This is a proposed exchange rule change, not a final SEC rule, so firms should review and comment before implementation details settle.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe C2 Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: The SEC published notice of Cboe C2’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule for certain Open-Close Data free trials. Instead of letting each requester choose any six-month historical window, all participants would receive the fixed period July 1, 2022 to December 31, 2022 for the three data products. Comments are solicited; the filing is already effective.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fees Schedule Regarding Certain Free Trials
summary: Cboe EDGX filed a proposed rule change to amend its fee schedule so all free trials for its Open-Close Data products use the same fixed historical sample period, July 1, 2022 through December 31, 2022, instead of letting each requester choose any six-month window. The SEC notice solicits comments; the change is not yet final.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Exchange's Connectivity Schedule and Discontinue a Previously Proposed Offering
summary: Nasdaq ISE filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to clean up its connectivity schedule by removing terminated fiber-optic and wireless market data connectivity offerings and dropping an unimplemented POD colocation offering. The filing is open for SEC comment, and no new customer obligation is created beyond the exchange’s rulebook update. The terminated offerings are effective as of August 31, 2025 or September 30, 2026, as stated.

title: Request for Comment on the Listing of Compute Derivatives Contracts
summary: The CFTC is seeking comment on a proposed approach to the listing of compute derivatives contracts on designated contract markets. Market participants may comment by 2026-10-20. This is an input-gathering proposal only; it does not itself impose new requirements.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE American LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.18E Regarding Trading Halts
summary: The SEC noticed NYSE American’s immediately effective proposed rule change to amend Rule 7.18E on trading halts and resumptions for securities subject to certain corporate actions. It applies to NYSE American-listed securities and is part of the market’s move toward 23/5 trading. No compliance deadline is stated in the notice; firms should monitor the final operative rule and related exchange implementation.

title: ARK Venture Fund and ARK Investment Management LLC
summary: The SEC published a notice of an application by ARK Venture Fund and ARK Investment Management LLC to amend a prior exemptive order. The requested amendment would let the fund offer a listed exchange class and a tokenized class traded on ATSs, instead of relying only on the prior interval-fund structure. Interested persons may request a hearing by 2026-09-18.

title: Disclosure of Information; Extension of Comment Period
summary: The FDIC has extended the comment period for its proposed rule on disclosure of information. Comments on the proposal, which would update FDIC rules on confidential supervisory information, FOIA disclosures and legal-process disclosures, are now due by 2026-10-05 instead of 2026-08-31.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Delay the Implementation of SR-ISE-2026-18
summary: Nasdaq ISE filed an immediately effective proposed rule change to delay the implementation of SR-ISE-2026-18. The exchange says the underlying auction-mechanism changes are unchanged and the outside implementation date is extended to on or before 2026-11-10, with a later Options Trader Alert to announce the exact date.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; CME Securities Clearing Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt Standards for Establishing Cross-Margin Arrangements and Adopt a Cross-Margin Arrangement With Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc.
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on CME Securities Clearing Inc.’s proposed rule change to add cross-margining standards and implement an initial cross-margin arrangement with CME. The filing would revise CMESC rulebook provisions and related risk-management policies for cross-margining of eligible securities transactions and interest rate futures. No compliance date is set yet; comments are being solicited.

title: SEC Proposes to Modernize Rules for Registered Transfer Agents
summary: The SEC is proposing to modernize the rules and forms for registered transfer agents, including amendments to registration, annual reporting, processing, recordkeeping and safeguarding rules, plus new rules and a rescission. The proposal would affect registered transfer agents and related securities processing activities. Comments are due by 2026-11-03.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt New Rule 24 Under Article 22 of the NYSE Texas Rule Book
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on NYSE Texas’s proposed rule change to add Rule 24 to its rule book. The rule would provide complimentary services to all listed issuers and a visibility/investor-engagement package for eligible dual listings meeting a 160 million shares-outstanding threshold. No compliance date is set because this is only a proposal.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; MIAX Sapphire, LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Fees and Rebates for Professional Customer Orders for QCC and cQCC Transactions and Establish a Tiered Fee Structure for Away Market Maker Facilitation of Customer QFOs or cQFOs
summary: MIAX Sapphire filed and immediately made effective a proposed options fee schedule change for Professional Customer QCC/cQCC transactions and certain Trading Floor QFO/cQFO facilitation trades. It lowers some fees and rebates and adds a tiered fee structure based on breakup percentages and minimum sizes. The SEC is seeking comments; the filing is dated August 17, 2026, and the notice was published August 28, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rule Equity 7 Regarding Pricing of Ports for the Night Session
summary: Nasdaq filed a proposed rule change, immediately effective, to amend Equity 7 fees for ports used to connect to its Night Session trading environment and to add fee waivers for members. The exchange said it plans to implement the fee changes on 2026-09-01. This is a US exchange filing open for comment and affects market participants using Night Session access ports.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Implement an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Program
summary: The SEC has published notice of Cboe BZX Exchange’s proposed fee-schedule change to create an Exchange Order Entry Protocol Migration Program. Eligible members could receive fee credits for temporary redundant logical ports used only as backup connections during an exchange-initiated migration, subject to notice, cancellation, usage, and credit-request conditions. This is a proposal/open for comment, not a final rule.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Options Clearing Corporation; Notice of Filing of Proposed Rule Change by The Options Clearing Corporation Concerning Amendments to Its Clearing Membership Standards
summary: The SEC has published a notice of OCC’s proposed rule change to amend clearing membership standards. It would tighten onboarding and ongoing risk requirements, raise certain capital-related expectations, expand grounds for denial or suspension, and broaden risk committee delegated authority. This is a consultation stage filing for comments, with no binding change yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Permit a New Issue ETPs To Commence Trading at the Beginning of the Pre-Market Session
summary: Texas Stock Exchange proposes a rule change to let new issue ETPs start trading at the beginning of the pre-market session unless the issuer opts for an IPO Auction, and to clean up related auction rule text. This is a proposed SEC notice for exchange members and market participants; comments are being solicited, but no firm compliance deadline is stated.

title: Superfund Tax on Chemical Substances; Request To Modify List of Taxable Substances; Notice of Filing for Butadiene-acrylonitrile-methyl Methacrylate-styrene Copolymer; w=124.79, x=424.05, y=129.62, z=72.41
summary: The IRS published a notice of filing and request for comments on a petition to add Modified SAN Latex to the U.S. Superfund list of taxable substances. Comments and hearing requests are due by 2026-11-09. The notice itself does not change the tax list, but it signals a potential future excise tax impact for importers and exporters of the substance.

title: Political Contributions by Certain Investment Advisers
summary: The SEC proposes to rescind the Advisers Act political contribution rule for investment advisers and to make related books-and-records amendments. The proposal is open for comment until 2026-11-09. It would affect advisers to government clients and their compliance programs if adopted.

title: Financial Institution Letter: Proposed Interagency Third-Party Risk Management Guidance and Issuance of Joint Statement on Community Banks’ Engagement with Core Service Providers
summary: The FDIC, OCC, FRB and NCUA have issued proposed interagency third-party risk management guidance for public comment, intended to replace existing guidance and emphasize tailoring controls to the level of risk. They also issued a joint statement on community banks’ engagement with core service providers. The proposal applies to FDIC-supervised financial institutions; no binding deadline is stated in the excerpt.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Texas, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Add a New Partial Cabinet Solution Bundle as Part of Its Co-Location Services
summary: NYSE Texas filed a proposed rule change to add a new 4 kW Partial Cabinet Solution co-location bundle, relabel the existing bundle options, and tidy a timing-protocol reference in its fee schedule. The change is not yet final; the exchange expects it to become operative by 2026-10-31 and the SEC is soliciting comments.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of “Trading Platform”
summary: The SEC is seeking comments on a Cboe EDGX proposed rule change to update its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” so it also covers similar order-matching venues and decentralized or tokenized platforms. This affects entities using EDGX fee schedules and related trading venues. No compliance date is set in the notice.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGA Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Exchange Rules 11.1, 11.6, 11.7, and 11.8 To Add a New Time-in-Force Designation Known as “Regular `til Post Market”
summary: Cboe EDGA has filed a proposed rule change to add a new time-in-force order type, “Regular ’til Post Market,” for execution during regular trading hours and the post-closing session, and to make conforming rule updates. This is a proposal, not a final rule. Comments were being solicited when published; no compliance date is stated.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To Permit the Listing of Binary KPI Options
summary: The SEC is soliciting comments on NYSE Arca’s proposed rule change to allow listing of binary KPI options tied to issuer-reported performance metrics. This is a proposed exchange rule change, so firms involved in options trading or product governance should review the proposal and comment if relevant; no compliance deadline applies yet.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.12 Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt in Connection With the Industry's Expansion of Trading Hours to 23 Hours per Day, 5 Days per Week
summary: The SEC published NYSE’s proposed rule change to amend Rule 7.12 on reopening trading after a Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halt, to align with expanded 23/5 trading hours. This is a solicitation of comments, not a final rule. No immediate operational change is stated for NYSE itself; the notice explains the rule change in the context of planned overnight trading from December 6, 2026.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Investors Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Address Internal Inconsistencies in Rule 22.260 in Advance of the Launch of IEX Options
summary: The SEC published notice of IEX’s proposed immediate-effective rule change to fix internal inconsistencies in Rule 22.260 before IEX Options launches on 2026-10-02. It would delete Rule 22.260(b) and expand the orders exempted from Rule 22.260(e). The notice invites comments; it does not itself impose a new requirement on market participants.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq PHLX LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Adopt Options 10, Section 27, Influencing or Rewarding Employees of Others
summary: Nasdaq PHLX filed a proposed rule change to add Options 10, Section 27 on influencing or rewarding employees of others, largely mirroring FINRA Rule 3220. It would cap gifts/gratuities at $300 per person per year, require written agreements and records for certain employment-related payments, and allow exemptive relief. This is a proposal, so firms may comment before any further action.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; New York Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 7.10 Clearly Erroneous Executions
summary: NYSE has filed a proposed rule change to extend its clearly erroneous execution protections under Rule 7.10 to periods when overnight price bands apply for 23/5 trading. It is a consultation notice, not a final rule. Interested persons may submit comments; no compliance date is set in the text.

title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Modify the Implementation Schedule of Amendments To Schedule A to the FINRA By-Laws Adopted in SR-FINRA-2024-019 as Modified in SR-FINRA-2025-007
summary: FINRA filed a rule change, effective immediately upon filing, to modify the implementation schedule for previously adopted fee-related amendments to Schedule A of the FINRA By-Laws. The change affects the timing of certain Corporate Financing review fees for private placements and public offerings, which were postponed to January 1, 2027. FINRA also solicits comments on the proposal.
